instrument: BTCUSDT Bybit linear perpetual; not CFD XAU/EUR/BTC
selection: first-day-month public trades sample; convenience sample, not random or independent certification
zones: H1 base/departure demand/supply, available only after departure closes; H4 context prior completed candles; one M15 sweep/reclaim family as control
source: actual repo supply/demand zone functions will be audited before implementing; no grid search
absorption: counter-side taker notional in prior15s >=75th percentile of trailing30min 15s notional; directional adverse price change <=0.10 H1ATR; at least10s of valid quotes; opposing flow fraction>=0.60
replenishment_proxy: same price near zone before/after observed counter-side trades, retained as evidence only; not proof of iceberg
reclaim: after absorption price closes completed M1 on favorable side of zone proximal within10minutes; must wait for close; no future outcome used
stop: outside distal/sweep extreme plus0.10H1ATR, stop locked at entry, risk0.15-4H1ATR
target: 1R fixed across entry variants; target to opposing known zone also logged as room diagnostic
orderbook_clock: exchange publication timestamp + assumed1s availability; no arrival timestamps in archive
overlap: report paired zone opportunity outcomes plus independent one-position-per-variant ledgers; per-horizon independently
missing_data: fail closed; no CVD/absorption from missing tape or cancellations
